info.title: AI Learning Assistant API
info.description: Approved draft baseline. Final request and response schemas are generated from Zod as endpoints are implemented.

post.summary: Register a learner and optionally request coach approval

get.summary: Get the current user's safe profile
List active course cards and accessible courses
Get a course visible to the caller

patch.summary: Update or archive an owned course

get.summary: List join requests for an owned course

patch.summary: Approve or reject a join request
Reassign a course to an active coach

post.summary: Upload a document and enqueue ingestion

get.summary: Get ingestion status and safe diagnostics
List document metadata visible to the caller

delete.summary: Enqueue hard deletion of a document

post.description: Returns JSON by default or a post-validation SSE replay when requested. No answer is streamed before citation validation.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Use text/event-stream to replay the already-validated response as SSE.

200.description: Grounded response or a response event followed by a done event

get.summary: Get an owned conversation and messages

delete.summary: Hard-delete an owned conversation and its messages

post.summary: Generate a summary from selected sources

get.summary: List summaries visible to the caller

post.summary: Publish an owned coach summary draft

get.summary: List flashcard sets visible to the caller

post.summary: Publish an owned coach flashcard draft
Generate a private quiz or coach draft from selected sources

get.description: Learner view never includes correctOptionId or explanation before submission.

patch.summary: Edit draft or create a new quiz version

get.summary: List quizzes visible to the caller

post.summary: Submit answers and receive server-scored results

get.summary: List the current user's quiz attempts

post.summary: Submit or update feedback for an answer

patch.summary: Approve or reject a coach request
Change a user's role; self-role changes are forbidden
Suspend, stash or restore a user

post.summary: Issue a one-time password reset token

patch.summary: Update a validated non-secret configuration subset

post.summary: Retry a failed or dead-letter job

RefreshRequest.description: Body token is accepted only when ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_IN_BODY is enabled; browser clients use the Secure refresh cookie.

DocumentUploadRequest.description: Multipart upload. Course-scope files require the owning coach; personal files require an approved learner. Content is sent to Mistral for embeddings.

file.description: PDF, DOCX or UTF-8 TXT; maximum compressed size 10 MB
